sources.title: BARTNet: Context-Aware Deep Learning Framework for BART Ridership ...
sources.snippet: In this paper, we propose a novel context-aware deep learning-based framework, BARTNet, for forecasting Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART) ridership by integrating contextual and temporal data. sources.snippet: BARTNet is a deep learning-based framework designed to accurately forecast Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART) ridership by integrating temporal and contextual features such as weather, holidays, and station location. This project was accepted at IEEE CAI 2025.
